WHY_DURATION_MATTERS: 3416 s is 5.7x the 600 s Bash-tool ceiling, and a sub-agent may never background anything. A developer or reviewer told to 'run the full suite' is killed mid-run and reads as a FAILURE. Only a conductor (a main loop) may run this, backgrounded. Put a TARGETED selection in every sub-agent prompt. The pre-existing build-baselines/kbutillib.json records a command but NO duration, which is why this outgrew the ceiling unnoticed.

MACHINE_LOCAL_FAILURES_NOT_PRODUCT_DEFEC.cause: The h100 user config /home/chenry/.kbutillib/config.yaml leaks into these tests DESPITE their monkeypatched HOME. Proven: the resolved CouncilConfig reports source='packaged default + user ai_council section' with store='sqlite:////scratch/chenry/council/council.sqlite' and query_dirs=['/scratch/chenry/council/queries'], while the test had set HOME to an empty tmp_path. The extra 'mag' endpoint and 'smoke' profile come from the USER config (lines 150 and 206); the packaged default_config.yaml has mag COMMENTED OUT (line 59) and no smoke profile.
